en: AI Organizational Intelligence: A Research Map
zh: AI 组织智能研究地图：从 Agent Workflow 到 Cognitive Workflow

excerpts.zh: 任务流程关注完成工作，认知流程还关注人如何理解与判断。
excerpts.en: Task workflows focus on execution; cognitive workflows also consider understanding and judgment.

excerpts.zh: 重复任务、输出矛盾和上下文污染，是多 Agent 的组织问题。
excerpts.en: Duplicate work, conflicting outputs and context pollution are organizational problems for agents.

excerpts.zh: 角色边界可以帮助不完美的 Agent 互相发现错误。
excerpts.en: Role boundaries can help imperfect agents catch each other’s errors.

excerpts.zh: 跨系统协作还需要权限、审计和异常处理。
excerpts.en: Cross-system collaboration also needs permissions, auditing and failure handling.

excerpts.zh: 分工可以按专业划分，也可以按认知功能划分。
excerpts.en: Roles can be divided by expertise or by cognitive function.

excerpts.zh: 让所有 Agent 看见所有消息，并不总是最好的通信方式。
excerpts.en: Letting every agent see every message is not always the best communication design.

excerpts.zh: 先独立思考再讨论，可以作为避免相互污染的一种机制。
excerpts.en: Thinking independently before discussion is one possible way to limit mutual contamination.

excerpts.zh: 多数意见与专家意见冲突时，需要明确的决策机制。
excerpts.en: Conflicts between majority and expert views require an explicit decision mechanism.

excerpts.zh: 委员会、中心调度和对立角色组织，各有不同的取舍。
excerpts.en: Committees, central coordination and rival roles involve different trade-offs.

excerpts.zh: 人应该在什么时刻介入，比笼统地说人在回路中更具体。
excerpts.en: Asking when people should intervene is more precise than simply keeping them in the loop.

excerpts.zh: 共识质量应关注证据、适用边界和不确定性。
excerpts.en: Consensus quality should consider evidence, scope and uncertainty.

excerpts.zh: 停止条件可以考虑新增信息、讨论成本和剩余分歧的性质。
excerpts.en: Stopping conditions can consider new information, cost and the nature of remaining disagreements.
